title: Japan seeing UAP over the last five years

tellings.quote: Japan's popping off almost as if Japan's seeing stuff recently in the last 5 years or so.

plain: Japan seems to have been seeing a lot of UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, over roughly the last five years. So says Dylan Borland, a man who says a top government official told him aliens run everything. On the show he tells Michels that Japan is "popping off" as if it has been "seeing stuff recently," which, if true, would mean the sightings reach well beyond the United States.
